title: Policy defaults serializer and synthetic-profile prober for tenant econ/quant automation
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: We need a deterministic, auditable way to produce tenant-scoped default policies (batching, cache presize, quant tiers) that can be serialized, reviewed, and deployed across Dedicated and Private. Current heuristics are ad-hoc and encoded in multiple places; this PR introduces a policy defaults serializer and a synthetic-profile prober that generates deterministic example workloads so defaults can be validated in CI and by SRE.

Summary of changes: Introduces a small policy DSL and a serializer that emits canonical JSON policy bundles for tenants; implements a synthetic-profile prober that runs against the sampler and prefill subsystems to produce a compact profile used to pick batch/cache/quant defaults; provides a CLI (redwoodctl defaults serialize/probe) and a small REST endpoint for the policy service for on-demand probes; hooks into the defaults-as-code import pipeline so product can review generated bundles before applying.

What this enables: 1) deterministic defaults generation for tenant onboarding; 2) CI validation of defaults via synthetic-profile replay; 3) easier code review of default policies as serialized artifacts; 4) ability to snapshot and roll back defaults in the tenant defaults registry.

Compatibility and rollout: Backwards-compatible. The serializer produces bundles that match the existing policy schema; we added a v2 mime-type for the new compact profile artifacts but the previous pipeline still accepts them. Rollout plan: feature flagged behind feature/defaults-serializer; will enable for a small set of tenants and run for 48h before gradual enabling.

Testing: Unit tests for serializer and parser (coverage added for edge cases where workloads have heavy streaming tokens), integration tests that run the prober against a local prefiller/sampler mock, and an e2e smoke that verifies the imported bundle deploys to a dedicated tenant and returns the expected recommended batch/cache/quant selection.

Checklist: - [x] Policy DSL and serializer implementation - [x] Synthetic-profile prober + deterministic seed - [x] redwoodctl CLI commands + docs snippet - [x] REST probe endpoint gated by feature flag - [x] Unit/integration/e2e tests - [x] Migration/compatibility checks and release notes

Notes: This PR purposely keeps the prober lightweight (synthetic workloads, not full traffic replay) to avoid production load. The serializer includes metadata (probe seed, runtime heuristics, timestamp) for traceability. Future follow-ups will add exportable diffs and a UI reviewer in Console.

release_notes:
- Introduce policy defaults serializer (produces auditable tenant policy bundles)
- Add synthetic-profile prober for deterministic workload probing
- redwoodctl support for serialize/probe commands
- Feature-flagged REST probe endpoint (disabled by default)
notes_for_reviewer: Key risk: running prober against live runners can spike prefiller activity; feature flag and explicit target guard mitigate this. Please verify the feature flag rollout in the deployment plan before enabling for production tenants.
validation_summary: Serializer unit tests: 42 assertions. Prober deterministic replay: identical profiles across 10 runs with same seed. E2E smoke: imported bundle applied and returned expected recommended batch=16, cache_presize=256KB, quant_tier=Q4MICRO for the test tenant.
